mapper.insert: insert into habit (habit_id, member_no, record_date, breakfast, breakfast_time, lunch, lunch_time, dinner, dinner_time) values (#{habit_id},#{member_no},#{record_date},#{breakfast}, #{breakfast_time},#{lunch},#{lunch_time},dinner,dinner_time)
mapper.select: select nvl(count(*),0) from habit where ${searchKey} like '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'

select * from ( select rownum rnum, data.* from( select habit_id, member_no, record_date, breakfast, breakfast_time, lunch, lunch_time, dinner, dinner_time from habit where ${searchKey} like '%' || #{searchValue} || '%' order by habit_id desc) data)
where rnum>=#{start} and rnum<=#{end}
select habit_id, member_no, record_date, breakfast, breakfast_time, lunch, lunch_time, dinner, dinner_time from habit where num=#{num}
mapper.update: update habit set habit_id=#{habit_id}, member_no=#{member_no}, record_date=#{record_date}, breakfast=#{breakfast}, breakfast_time=#{breakfast_time}, breakfast=#{lunch}, breakfast_time=#{lunch_time}, breakfast=#{dinner}, breakfast_time=#{dinner_time} where habit_id=#{habit_id}
